title: Context Window
cap: The context window is a dynamic memory space that grows with each request, acting as a working set of notes for the current task.
note_head: Key Aspects of the Context Window

note_items.t: Dynamic Memory Allocation: The context window expands and contracts based on the current request, ensuring optimal memory usage.
Working Notes: It serves as a growing set of working notes for the current request, capturing all relevant information.
Model Weights: The machinery behind the context window, which are the model weights, remain static and are not part of the dynamic memory allocation.

The bit depth used for storing model weights and activations.
The number of concurrent sequences being processed.
